Why it can feel so confusing

What looks like one thing can be something else entirely.

The clues often connect in ways that aren’t obvious from the outside.

01

What you see

“They know what to do, but they just won't start.”

What may be underneath

  • Task initiation
  • Executive functioning
  • Regulation

02

What you see

“They only want the same few foods.”

What may be underneath

  • Sensory predictability
  • Language
  • Regulation

03

What you see

“Plans change and everything falls apart.”

What may be underneath

  • Transitions
  • Uncertainty
  • Regulation

When you understand what may be underneath,you can change what happens next.

How it works

One overwhelming task.One clear next step.

You tell Mission Accomplished what’s hard.
We help turn it into a challenge your child can understand, start, and finish.

  1. Parent

    You start with the real-life challenge.

  2. Mission Accomplished reframes it

    Clean Room

    Mission Accomplished turns one big ask into manageable steps.

    • Pop any clothes from the floor into the laundry basket
    • Put 5 books back on the shelf or in a neat stack
    • Give your stuffies and toys a cozy spot to rest
    • Smooth out your blanket and fluff your pillow
    • Take one last look and pick your favorite tidy spot to show off

    Mission Accomplished turns one big ask into manageable steps.

  3. Child

    Maddy sees what’s next — not the whole mountain.

One challenge at a time. Real progress every time.

Mission accomplished.

See the real experience in the app.

It starts with you

Before we help your child,we help you.

You’ve asked four times.
You’re both frustrated.
What do you try next?

Your Compass gives you a judgment-free place to figure out what may be going on and what to try next.

Helping your child starts with feeling supported yourself.

Try it for yourself

Try one small change tonight.

Choose a moment that tends to go sideways.
We’ll show you a different way to frame it.

Instead of

“Go get ready.”

Big request.
No clear starting point.

Turn it
into a
mission

Try this

“First challenge: can you get your socks and shoes on before I finish filling your water bottle?”

One clear challenge.
One visible first step.

Why this can helpIt gives the task a clear beginning and makes the first step feel smaller.

The whole program

More than an app.
Support built around your family.

Mission Accomplished combines everyday tools for your child, support for you, and personalized guidance from Jenilee.

  • For your child

    Everyday missions

    Challenges broken into manageable steps, rewards, streaks and progress toward the summit.

  • For you

    Parent support

    Check-ins, Your Compass, progress insights, community and tools for difficult moments.

  • With Jenilee

    Personalized guidance

    Consultations that help you understand patterns, set priorities and decide what to work on next.
